blocks.text: The World Cup-bound Filipinas kicked off the country’s football campaign in the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Monday by snatching a point. A late goal from Nathalie Collins secured a 1-1 draw against Uzbekistan in Gifu, a result that could play a role in the Filipinas’ bid to advance from the group stage in women’s football. […]...
